Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that âEX = CXâ: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

Â 

Agiloft's customers rely on our Ecosystem of System Integration (SI) partners to help them design, build and deliver solutions on the Agiloft platform. This role is designed to help our partners build robust capabilities within their organization and ultimately ensure our customers are realizing maximum value from the platform.

As Partner Solution Architect, you'll support the partners as a technical advisor for partner-led implementations from kickoff through go-live. You'll guide SIs on architecture, integrations, data sync, and configuration. When something breaks, you'll figure out whether it's a configuration issue, an integration issue, or a real product defect, and get it to the right owner.

You'll sit in the Partner Center of Excellence, the team responsible for making partner delivery repeatable and high quality. Our Partner Alliance Managers own the overall relationship with each partner and this role will be responsible for the successful technical outcome and capability development. You'll work daily with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll turn what you learn on each project into playbooks the whole ecosystem can use.

Â 

Job Responsibilities

What you'll do

Guide Partners to Go-live

Serve as the product & technical point of contact for SI partners and their customers during the implementation project and through go-live. Advise on solution architecture, integration design, data synchronization, and configuration best practices across Agiloft's platform: core CLM, procurement and source-to-pay workflows, ERP sync (such as SAP S/4HANA), APIs and MCP-based orchestration, and AI and analytics capabilities. Help partners separate out-of-the-box capability from custom implementation work so each fix lands with the right owner.

Own the Technical Escalation Path

Act as the Tier 3 technical resource for partner-led projects. Triage and reproduce issues, document them clearly, and log true defects and enhancement requests to Product and Engineering in Jira. Join partner and customer working sessions when a blocker needs Agiloft in the room. Hand accounts off cleanly to Support at transition, with documented configuration and open items.

Enable the Ecosystem

Build and deliver partner training, webinars, and learning content with Product and go-to-market teams. Work with Product and Engineering to stand up and maintain partner sandboxes, test environments, and knowledge base access. Support the change management and promote the value of monthly releases into the partner ecosystem.

Build the Playbook

Create and maintain implementation playbooks, a known-issue library, escalation runbooks, and environment setup guides. Feed patterns from real projects back into enablement, documentation, and the product roadmap.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

Partner-led go-lives land on schedule, with fewer slipping because of unresolved technical blockers. Technical escalations from partners reach a clear owner quickly, with reproducible detail, and resolve faster. Product and Engineering receive structured, prioritized signal from partner projects instead of ad hoc pulls. Product and Engineering receive a steady, well-documented stream of implementation feedback that shapes the roadmap. A working go-live toolkit exists and partners actually use it: playbooks, known-issue library, runbooks, reference architectures, and environment guides. Support inherits cleaner, better-documented accounts at handoff. Target metrics: e.g. on-time go-live rate, median time to resolve partner escalations, escalations per quarter, training events delivered. Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

What you'll bring

5+ years in a technical, customer- or partner-facing implementation role: solution architecture, professional services, implementation or integration consulting, or sales engineering with post-sale delivery. Agiloft certification, or relevant platform certifications (Salesforce, SAP, cloud). Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT), and data sync between systems of record. title: SEO - Manager
description:

Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.
Job Role: SEO / AEO Manager
Job Type: Contract - USA

Job Description

About This Role

Bounteous is leading the charge in dynamic digital experiences and is looking for forward-thinking search experts to help drive measurable impact for some of the world's most recognizable and ambitious brands. In today's AI-driven, zero-click search landscape, our approach helps brands envision, harness, and enable their digital presence across traditional search engines, AI-powered discovery platforms, and emerging search experiences.

We are seeking a SEO / AEO Manager to lead holistic search strategy across our client portfolio, spanning traditional SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and AI search visibility across platforms including Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot. This individual will drive performance across traditional SEO, AEO, and AI-powered search experiences. The ideal candidate understands how search has evolved beyond rankings- into entities, AI Overviews, generative search, and full-SERP ownership, and can translate that evolution into business growth. The ideal candidate has already built or scaled an AI-search-visibility practice, not just a traditional SEO program with AI terminology added on top.

This contractor will work cross-functionally with internal teams and client stakeholders to develop and execute advanced search strategies that drive visibility, authority, and measurable ROI, defined jointly with each client at engagement kickoff (see Success Metrics below).

Role & Responsibilities

As the SEO & AEO Manager, you will lead strategic search initiatives across enterprise client accounts, driving business growth and client success as a key member of our search practice.

You will own strategy development, execution oversight, and performance measurement across traditional SEO and AI-driven search ecosystems.

Â 

Key Responsibilities

Search & AEO Strategy Leadership

  • Lead holistic search strategy development, including traditional SEO, AEO, and AI search optimization, to drive full-funnel growth.

  • Develop strategies to capture and optimize for AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, People Also Ask, zero-click search experiences, and conversational queries.

  • Drive entity-based optimization strategies to strengthen brand authority and knowledge graph presence.

  • Partner with content and digital teams to align SEO strategy with E-E-A-T best practices.

AI & Emerging Search Optimization

  • Optimize content and technical implementations for AI-driven search environments, including generative search engines and LLM discovery platforms, specifically ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, Gemini, and Copilot.

  • Develop structured data and schema strategies to enhance visibility in rich results, AI summaries, and enhanced SERP features.

  • Stand up and manage AI-visibility monitoring using a dedicated citation-tracking platform â track share of AI citations, sentiment, and source attribution across client brands and named competitors.

  • Monitor evolving search engine algorithms and AI search trends, proactively adjusting strategy to maintain competitive advantage.

  • Establish processes for measuring AI search visibility and zero-click performance impact.

Technical & Content SEO Execution

  • Perform and present comprehensive technical, content, competitive, local, and app SEO audits.

  • Develop SEO functional specifications for technical enhancements, partnering with developers to implement, QA, and UAT updates.

  • Conduct advanced keyword, topic cluster, and entity research to inform scalable content strategies.

  • Identify opportunities for content optimization, consolidation, pruning, and authority building.

Cross-Functional & Client Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with paid search, analytics, UX, product, and development teams to drive integrated search performance.

  • Present insights and recommendations to internal and client stakeholders, translating complex SEO and AI-search concepts into business-focused outcomes.

  • Align search strategies with broader omnichannel marketing and digital transformation initiatives.

Data, Measurement & Automation

  • Take a data-driven approach to measuring SEO and AEO ROI against the metrics defined in Success Metrics below.

  • Develop reporting frameworks that account for traditional traffic, zero-click engagement, SERP feature ownership, and AI search visibility.

  • Leverage automation tools, APIs, AI workflows, and scripting (e.g., Python, Google Apps Script, or SQL) to improve efficiency and scalability. ~~advanced Excel or scripting capabilities~~

  • Use reporting and visualization platforms (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau) to communicate performance insights and strategic opportunities.

Project Management & Delivery

  • Manage project timelines and deliverables within project management systems (e.g., JIRA), ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met.

  • Operate effectively in a contractor capacity, managing priorities across multiple accounts while maintaining strategic clarity and execution rigor.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6-8years of experience driving SEO performance for enterprise or large-scale brands, including client-facing or agency experience

  • Demonstrated ownership of both traditional SEO and AEO/GEO initiatives, including having built an AI-search-visibility measurement practice from scratch â not just applied AEO terminology to an existing SEO program.

  • AI Overviews and generative search experiences

  • Structured data and schema implementation

  • Entity-based optimization and knowledge graph strategy

  • E-E-A-T frameworks and authority-building strategies

  • Hands-on experience with leading SEO platforms: SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Lumar (DeepCrawl), Yext, Lighthouse, and Google Business Profile.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one dedicated AI-visibility/citation-tracking platform (e.g., Profound, Peec AI, Scrunch AI, AthenaHQ, or the AI-visibility modules within Semrush/Ahrefs).

  • Experience managing project timelines and deliverables within a PM system (e.g., JIRA).

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and business recommendations.

  • Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to senior stakeholders and client leadership teams.

Â 

Preferred

  • Familiarity with AI-powered workflows, automation tools, APIs, and scripting (Python, SQL, or Google Apps Script) for reporting automation.

  • Prior experience managing search strategy across multiple concurrent client accounts in an agency or consultancy setting.

Information Security Responsibilities

  • Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets

You'll work closely with Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product. You'll take feedback from senior leadership and partner teams, and you'll give it back just as directly. Politics have no place here, and the best work wins the argument.

Experience

  • Exacting taste and the judgment to tell great work from good work.

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
Employment type: Full-time
Experience: 4+ years
Reports to: Chris Stella, VP Growth

About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you've audited our current journeys and data, launched a rebuilt lead nurture and new-member onboarding journey, and set up clear reporting on conversion and activation by stage.
  • In your first year: you're running a full lifecycle program from lead to long-term member, with a steady testing cadence, measurable gains in lead-to-member conversion, activation, and retention, and journeys that scale to new markets and ULC locations.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business. Hands-on experience building journeys in a platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo. Strong copywriting skills across email, SMS, and push. Comfort with data: segmentation, A/B testing, cohort analysis, and reporting. SQL is a plus. Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up content and analysis. Clear written and verbal communication. Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

Experience in digital health, telehealth, wellness, or healthcare. Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM requirements. Experience with Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or a similar data stack. Experience at a startup or high-growth company. Experience building a lifecycle program from scratch.

Traits for Success

  • Passionate about health, wellness, longevity, or human performance.
  • Writes clearly and cares about the member on the other end of every message.
  • Tests everything and lets the data decide.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just planning it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment
  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment
  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Enablement
description:
Software development is changing fast, and code is no longer written by humans alone. Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Built on a decade as the world's leading secure coding training platform, we're trusted by enterprises worldwide. We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom.
Â 
Join Secure Code Warrior and help us in our mission to create a safer digital landscape. Weâre empowering organizations to secure their softwareâno matter how the code is written!

We're looking for a self-starter to own revenue enablement for our global go-to-market team across the US, EMEA and APAC. You'll make sure every seller, BDR, sales engineer and customer success manager can explain what we do, run a sharp discovery conversation with a CISO or VP of Engineering, handle the tough objections, and win against the competition.

This role sits in Product Marketing, so you won't just run programs â you'll build the content yourself: product and competitive enablement, objection handling, onboarding and sales plays. You'll work within a small, fast-moving product marketing team where your work shows up in the field within days, not quarters.

What you'll do

Get the field ready for every launch. Turn new products and capabilities into talk tracks, demo paths, short videos and AI-driven self-training modules, so the field knows the story before customers ask.

Make discovery and objection handling a strength. Build discovery guides for the three people in every deal: the CISO or Head of AppSec, the CTO or VP of Engineering, and the Head of AI Governance. Keep a living objection library grounded in real calls, and run the practice that makes it stick.

Track the competition and find where we win. Follow competitor moves and market trends, mine win/loss data and call recordings, and bring that evidence to Product Marketing to sharpen our messaging. Build battlecards and sales plays backed by proof we can show a customer.

Build learning paths and certifications. Create role-based learning paths and certifications for AEs, SEs and CSMs, so everyone is ready before they pitch something new.

Own onboarding, globally. Run one onboarding program for every new GTM hire, from Sydney to San Francisco to Belgium. Set clear ramp milestones and keep making it faster.

Listen first, then build. Spend time with sellers, BDRs, sales leaders, SEs and customer success to understand what they actually need. Test drafts early, ask for feedback and iterate. Measure what gets used and what helps win deals, and retire what doesn't.

Show up at the big moments. Help shape enablement for Revenue Kickoff and product launches across all three regions.

Who you are

A self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it. You don't need a detailed brief or a big team behind you, and you're happiest building something from a blank page.

A collaborator who asks before building. You'd rather spend an hour with a seller than a week guessing. You ask for feedback early and often, you deliver what the team needs, and you never build in a vacuum and hand it down.

Decisive, with conviction. Listening doesn't mean building by committee. You know which feedback to act on and which to set aside, and you'll move on instinct with limited input rather than wait for consensus. Strong opinions don't knock you off course: you stick with what you know will work, and you say no, kindly and clearly, to what won't.

Crisp and clear. You can turn a complex technical product into something a seller can say in 30 seconds and a CISO will care about. You write tight and cut what doesn't earn its place.

Energized by pace. Our market moves every week. Priorities shift, new competitors appear, AI changes the rules. You find that exciting, not overwhelming, and you know how to ship something good fast and improve it later.

Curious about AI. You don't need to be an expert today, but you're excited to make AI part of how you work. We'll invest in your skills, and you'll help us figure out how AI can make enablement faster and better.

What you bring

6â9 years in revenue or sales enablement, sales engineering, product marketing or another customer-facing role at a B2B software company

3+ years in cybersecurity, application security or DevSecOps, with a real understanding of how CISOs, AppSec leaders and engineering executives evaluate and buy

A portfolio of enablement content you built yourself â talk tracks, demo scripts, battlecards, training â and evidence of what it changed

Experience building onboarding and discovery or objection-handling programs for Enterprise and mid-market sales teams

Comfort with technical topics: the software development lifecycle, code security and AI/LLMs

Experience enabling teams across time zones, with a strong instinct for content people can use on their own

Familiarity with a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, and tools like Salesforce and Clari

Nice to have

Competitive intelligence or product marketing experience

A background as a sales engineer or seller

Experience at a fast-growing company where you were the first or only person in your function

Why you'll like it here

Wide scope, real impact. You'll own enablement end to end and see your work change deals quickly.

A direct line to messaging. What you learn in the field shapes how SCW talks about itself.

Backup when you need it. You'll work alongside a Product Marketing team and SCW's AI Center of Excellence, which will help you build your AI skills and workflows.

A market that matters. AI is changing how software gets built, and security leaders need help keeping up. You'll be helping them do it.

Location

This is a remote role based in the US. We strongly prefer candidates in the Pacific Time zone, so you can work with teams in EMEA in the morning and APAC in the afternoon. Some travel for Revenue Kickoff and regional events.

You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and youâre a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters.

We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you.

You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior.

We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same.

You will be responsible for growing existing accounts, securing new customers, and building a sustainable pipeline across the telecommunications ecosystem. Work closely with Inside Sales and Demand Generation teams to identify target accounts, generate qualified leads, build pipeline, and accelerate sales opportunities. Maintain accurate CRM records, ensuring clear visibility of opportunity status, pipeline coverage, customer engagement, next steps, and revenue forecasts. Essential Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior and executive customer stakeholders, bringing D&Bâs best ideas, innovations, service capabilities and peer best practices to help Clients achieve measurable business outcomes.

title: Analytics Manager
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About the role At Moniepoint, as an Analytics Manager, you will use data to make better decisions, faster for the business. You will own metrics, measurement, experimentation and the analysis/data roadmap for a business area. You’ll use data to quantify business KPIs and conduct analyses to uncover unknowns, helping the business unit achieve its goals for acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and revenue. As a leader of the business unit, the role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and growth. What you’ll do Strategic Leadership: Build a disciplined, exceptional analytical team. Develop and execute a comprehensive data and analytics roadmap and strategy Team Building & Management: Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of analytics professionals Data Insights & Analytics - including forecast building, business analysis and model development and productionisation. Drive the generation of actionable insights from data to support various business functions, including product, operations, marketing and engineering. What is our actual CAC per channel? Which customer segments are more/less engaged? What are our customers’ share of wallet - how can we use this? What is the typical behaviour of a Moniepoint consumer? What products cause the biggest incremental engagement? Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with growth, product, and engineering managers to ensure we collect the right data for meaningful business insights. Bring data leadership and rigour to our approach to product development. Build a strategic understanding of the business and structure complex projects to bring them to life. Business: Growth Create and maintain the yearly forecast and budget for your products. Define the product's growth plan and lead execution across the entire funnel from acquisition through to monetisation and retention Own and optimise specific business metrics or commercial goals, covering the entire funnel from new user acquisition through conversion, activation, retention, and expansion  Perform detailed product analysis covering the product management funnel with all its aspects, implementing changes into the buying funnel to improve conversion Design and execute A/B testing programs to optimise sales and conversion rates/adoption at each funnel stage Lead testing and optimisation efforts for the conversion funnel across offline and online channels, prioritising tests that drive the biggest business impact Improve the product's design and deploy experiments to improve lifetime value (LTV) and decrease churn  Technical: Data & Analytics Use deep, flexible, and comprehensive analytics covering the entire funnel from marketing acquisition to product usage Analyse user behaviour to improve the sales funnel and increase conversions, using advanced analytics to assess campaign performance and refine strategies Define and track growth metrics including customer acquisition cost (CAC), activation rate, retention rate, payback time, and revenue per customer Conduct cohort analysis and journey mapping to identify bottlenecks and optimisation opportunities What you need to succeed +5 years in Analytics and Analytics Management. 2+ years in a management role managing teams and driving strategic initiatives Proven track record in a consumer-FMCG environment, preferably in a CPG or fintech environment Deep experience scaling product businesses, with demonstrated ownership of significant revenue targets Technical Skills Strong analytical skills with ability to drive metrics and benchmarks, plus experience with growth experiments, A/B testing, and funnel optimisation Deep SQL knowledge. Proficiency in product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Grafana, Tableau, Looker, etc) Deep understanding of data analytics, user behaviour analysis and segmentation Leadership & Soft Skills Strong communication skills to interact with teams, stakeholders, and users through verbal presentations, written reports, and visual media  Proven ability to build, mentor, and scale high-performing product teams Expertise in data analytics tools and digital marketing platforms with the ability to manage and mentor teams of marketers, analysts, and designers Strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness and business acumen Key Performance Indicators User acquisition and activation rates Customer retention and churn rates Expansion revenue (upsell/cross-sell) Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) / Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) ratio Product adoption metrics What sets you apart Advanced degree in Business or STEM Experience in Growth Analytics, Product analytics, Credit risk analytics Background in both mass-marketing and product-led growth models Experience managing P&L or budget responsibility What you’ll get Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits. What to expect in the hiring process Online SQL take-home task (30 mins): Take-home test. Business Case 1 (1 hour - 1 hour 30 mins): Live case. No take-home required. Business Case 2 (1 hour - 1 hour 30 mins): Live case. No take-home required. Exec Interview (30 mins - 1 hour): Culture Fit. No take-home required.

title: Branch Experience Manager - Kaduna
description: About us Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira’s in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere. About this role The Branch Experience Manager (XM) is the daily operational commander of the branch and the person accountable for how every customer experiences it. The role exists to make sure customers are served quickly, treated well, and leave satisfied, while the branch runs smoothly, safely, and in line with policy. This is a service-and-operations leadership role first; growth and commercial targets are owned above the branch at the regional layer. Responsibilities Customer Experience Own the end-to-end customer experience: first impression on arrival, journey through the service zones, and how the customer feels on exit Set and hold the premium service standard expected of a Moniepoint branch, and model it personally on the floor Resolve customer complaints and escalations quickly, and use recurring issues to improve how the branch runs Queue & Flow Management Run the queueing system actively: monitor wait times, anticipate build-ups, and intervene before queues form rather than after Coordinate staff movement across zones in real workstreams Act as first responder for in-branch escalations, system downtime, and technical disruptions, coordinating a fast return to service Oversee opening and closing readiness, branch presentation, and the safe, compliant running of the premises At regional branches, hold oversight of cash and vault operations under dual control, while keeping the role independent of cash custody Operations Supervisor can deputise fully in the XM's absence Report daily branch performance, service metrics, and incidents to the Regional Operations Manager Experience & Background Degree in a relevant field 5+ years in branch operations, service management, or a customer-facing leadership role in banking or financial services Sound understanding of CBN regulations, KYC, and branch compliance Comfortable with a digital, paperless service model and with reading operational data Skills & Competencies Strong customer-service orientation with a genuine instinct for how a branch should feel to a customer Proven ability to lead a team and stay calm under pressure during peak traffic or system issues Proactive queue and floor management skills to anticipate bottlenecks and reallocate resources in real time Strong operational discipline, compliance mindset, and incident-response coordination What success looks like in this role Low average customer wait times and a high percentage of customers served within target Strong customer satisfaction and service quality scores Fast complaint resolution rates and turnaround times, paired with continuous operational improvements from recurring feedback High branch uptime and rapid recovery from technical or operational disruptions Strong audit and compliance ratings, with clear daily reporting and a fully capable deputy in the Operations Supervisor

title: Business Relationship Manager (Bauchi)
description: Business Relationship Manager  Department / Function: Commercial & Field Operations Reports To: State Coordinator Location: Field-based, Nigeria Employment Type: Full-time Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance-based commission About Moniepoint Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions and process over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. Job purpose Drives business growth by expanding our merchant footprint, building high-value customer relationships, and introducing financial solutions tailored to local business needs. This role is responsible for end-to-end merchant acquisition, terminal deployment, and account retention across assigned commercial areas. Key responsibilities → Identify, visit, and onboard prospective merchants through field engagement, referrals, and local trade community outreach. → Educate business owners on Moniepoint’s suite of products, recommending solutions that match their operational and growth goals. → Achieve and exceed monthly targets for active merchant onboarding, terminal deployment, loan disbursements, and repayments. → Oversee end-to-end merchant onboarding, ensuring accurate KYC documentation and strict adherence to operational SOPs and regulatory guidelines. → Build and nurture long-term relationships with merchants to encourage account activity, high transaction volume, and ongoing retention. → Conduct transparent discussions on pricing, terms, and agreements within established company guidelines to build trusted partnerships. → Serve as the primary point of contact for customer queries, resolving issues promptly or escalating complex operational needs appropriately. → Gather local market intelligence and competitor activity, providing actionable feedback to field leadership to help refine growth tactics. → Maintain accurate pipeline records and submit timely field performance reports using CRM tools. Qualifications → Bachelor’s degree, Higher National Diploma (HND), or Ordinary National Diploma (OND) from a recognised tertiary institution. → 2 to 4 years of hands-on sales experience, preferably within banking, fintech, payment services, or fast-moving commercial environments. → Proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets in merchant onboarding, field sales, or client acquisition. → Deep understanding of the local financial services landscape and regional trading dynamics. → Strong communication and customer relationship skills.   Preferred qualifications → Practical experience with POS terminal deployment, payment acquiring, or business loan products. → Proficiency in CRM software for field tracking, pipeline management, and activity reporting.   About you → You build trust easily: You connect genuinely with everyday business owners and build lasting community relationships. → You are driven by impact: You take ownership of your goals and take pride in helping local businesses succeed. → You keep things clear and simple: You explain complex financial features in straightforward, approachable language. → You operate with integrity: You pursue targets with energy while upholding high standards of compliance and quality. → You are structured and adaptable: You organize your daily field schedule efficiently and adapt quickly to market feedback. What success looks like → Target achievement: Consistently meeting monthly and quarterly targets for merchant acquisition, terminal deployment, loan disbursements, and transaction volume. → Account health & retention: Maintaining high activity levels, retention rates, and active usage across onboarded merchant accounts. → Quality & compliance: Achieving high conversion rates through accurate lead qualification and zero compliance exceptions during KYC verification. → Merchant satisfaction: Establishing long-term relationships that generate organic customer referrals and sustained account growth.

title: Early Careers Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: About Moniepoint and Your Team At Moniepoint, we are on a mission to create financial happiness for every African, everywhere. From pioneering digital payments to powering millions of businesses across the continent, we build innovative, dependable products that everyday people rely on. As part of the People Team, Talent Acquisition doesn't just fill open roles; we shape how great talent discovers, joins, and thrives at Moniepoint. You'll join a collaborative, ambitious team of recruiters, sourcers, and operations specialists who care deeply about candidate experience, equity, and operational excellence. Job Purpose The Early Careers TA Specialist leads the operational delivery of Moniepoint's structured early-talent ecosystem, spanning university partnerships, campus hackathons, structured internships, and graduate conversions. In this role, you'll partner closely with the Senior TA Strategy & Enablement Manager to turn strategic vision into high-impact, repeatable programmes. You'll own the day-to-day rhythm of our campus presence and early-career cohorts, ensuring every student, graduate, and intern experiences a transparent, supportive, and inspiring journey into Moniepoint. Key Responsibilities 1. Campus Engagement & Community Presence Build and execute a clear, engaging playbook for how Moniepoint connects with university students and emerging talent through hackathons, tech talks, campus career fairs, and community hubs. Run the annual early-careers recruiting calendar, aligning outreach windows, assessment cycles, and start dates into a predictable, well-communicated rhythm. Establish and nurture long-term partnerships with universities, student societies, and tech communities across Nigeria to build balanced, diverse talent pipelines year after year. 2. Internship & Graduate Programme Delivery Deliver a structured, end-to-end internship experience—including recruiting, pre-boarding, cohort programming, manager enablement, and conversion into full-time roles. Partner with hiring managers and team leads to define project scopes, secure dedicated mentors, and ensure interns work on meaningful, real-world problems. Manage transparent, objective conversion assessments at each stage of the cohort lifecycle using structured, skill-based criteria. 3. Recruiting Infrastructure & Candidate Experience Design and manage smooth application, screening, and interview workflows for high-volume cohorts within our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Collaborate with assessment partners and vendors to deliver fair, accessible, and bias-free evaluation stages for all candidates. Coordinate with People Operations, IT, and workplace teams to ensure seamless onboarding and Day 1 readiness for every cohort. Provide mentorship and day-to-day guidance to junior recruiters or coordinators supporting early-talent pipelines as the function expands. 4. Insights, Reporting & Continuous Improvement Track key programme metrics, including application conversion rates, cohort diversity, candidate Net Promoter Score (NPS), and post-internship retention. Gather feedback from candidates, interns, and hiring managers to simplify processes and continuously improve programme quality. Share regular progress updates and data-driven recommendations with the wider TA leadership. Qualifications 5-7 years of talent acquisition experience, with proven exposure to campus recruiting, university relations, early-career programmes, or cohort hiring. Demonstrated experience coordinating complex projects or multi-stakeholder programmes with strong attention to detail and follow-through. Practical experience using modern Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and candidate evaluation tools. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to connect authentically with university students and senior stakeholders alike. Solid understanding of the Nigerian higher education landscape and emerging talent communities. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing or running student hackathons, innovation challenges, or specialized STEM recruitment initiatives. Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, or fast-paced corporate environments. Familiarity with funnel analytics, spreadsheet reporting, or presentation design for leadership reviews. About You You're an empathetic communicator: You listen well, build genuine trust with students and hiring managers, and make every candidate feel valued and respected. You bring structure to complex projects: You enjoy taking multiple moving parts—dates, venues, mentors, candidate lists—and organizing them into clear, dependable workflows. You're a collaborative problem-solver: You approach challenges with curiosity, ask thoughtful questions, and work constructively with hiring managers to find solutions that benefit everyone. You care deeply about fairness: You believe great talent comes from diverse backgrounds, and you actively champion objective, inclusive hiring practices. You're human and grounded: You communicate with clarity, keep things simple, and bring positive energy and humility to your team every day. Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Field Credit Officer (Edo North, Central and Ovia)
description: About Us:  Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere. Job Title: Field Credit Officer  Reports to: Regional Credit Manager  Employment Type: Outsourced  Work Mode: Onsite About this role:  As a Field Credit Officer, you would be saddled with the duty of onboarding and managing businesses that would access our credit products. You would be tasked with growing your loan portfolio while maintaining profitability by ensuring that all loans are repaid as and when due. As a result, you would play a vital role in the assessment of these businesses during their credit application and leverage innovative tools we have developed to help you monitor their performance during the course of the loan. You would also be responsible for making deductions from several information sources about the 5Cs of credit, with capacity, character, and capital as major priorities. Make recommendations to management before, during, and after the disbursement of a loan facility as to the best actions to be taken, considering several economic factors. Responsibilities: Identify and onboard viable businesses within your assigned geographical area to open business accounts with Moniepoint  Engage customers to ensure optimal usage of accounts to allow them to qualify for access to credit  Review and approve (or decline) loan requests by thoroughly analyzing all the data available  Embark on physical visitation to potential borrowers’ business places for evaluation of business books, taking inventory and turnover into consideration  Meet gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets by maintaining a healthy number of loan customers while ensuring that all loans in portfolio are performing  Monitor active loan portfolio to ensure continued use of business account and loan repayment performance  Perform all other credit-related functions as may be assigned by a supervisor  Experience & Background: Minimum of an OND in any business-related discipline  Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a sales role for credit products in a financial institution  Demonstrable knowledge of credit risk analysis  Good knowledge of financial analysis is an added advantage  Must reside within Edo North, Central or Ovia. Skills & Competencies: Apt attention to details  Proven simple/complex analytical skills  Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills  Agility and perseverance  What success looks like in this role: Consistent achievement of gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets.  Maintaining a healthy, performing loan portfolio with minimized default rates through rigorous physical visitations and monitoring.  Successful onboarding and engagement of viable businesses that actively utilize Moniepoint business accounts.  Accurate credit risk assessments based on key factors like capacity, character, and capital.  Why join us:  Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.  Opportunity to work with Africa’s fastest-growing fintech and make a direct impact on business growth across the region.

title: Field Sales Lead (Anambra)
description: About us Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere. About Moniebook The all-in-one business management software for retail and restaurant businesses. We sell, track inventory, manage bookkeeping, and accept payments — all from one platform. Offline-first, mobile-ready, and built for how Nigerian businesses actually operate. For more info https://moniepoint.com/moniebook Job Title: Field Sales Lead Reports to: Head, Customer Acquisition Location: Nigeria (Field) About this role The Field Sales Lead drives acquisition and conversion performance across assigned regions by recruiting, managing, coaching, and supporting a team of Field Sales Agents (FSAs). You will serve as the operational hub of the regional field sales function, owning agent recruitment pipelines, ensuring consistent field activity, and delivering against regional acquisition targets. This is a hands-on, frontline role that combines team building with active performance management and structured field support. Responsibilities Team Leadership & Coaching Lead & Develop: Manage a team of Field Sales Agents across assigned states, providing daily direction, motivation, and performance support. Coach: Conduct regular meetings, field ride-alongs, and coaching sessions to develop FSAs' product knowledge, objection handling, and acquisition skills. Onboard: Onboard new Field Sales Agents and ensure they are fully ramped and hitting activity targets within their first 30 days. Performance Management: Identify frontline skill gaps and run targeted coaching interventions to address them quickly. FSA Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Recruit: Own the end-to-end recruitment pipeline for Field Sales Agents in your region, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and recommending candidates for hire. Pipeline Building: Maintain a live talent bench by proactively building relationships with potential FSA candidates in your states, ensuring the region is never understaffed. Workforce Planning: Partner with the Operations team to forecast FSA headcount needs based on regional acquisition targets and attrition trends. Recruitment Reporting: Track time-to-fill and onboarding completion rates, flagging recruitment blockers to leadership in a timely manner. Sales Operations & Performance Drive Targets: Own region-level acquisition targets (weekly and monthly) and ensure individual FSAs meet their assigned quotas. Track Activity: Monitor daily field activity metrics, visits completed, leads generated, acquisitions recorded, and follow-ups made, and intervene when performance trends downward. Field Support: Join FSAs in the field to support complex or at-risk acquisition opportunities where direct engagement is needed. Pipeline Management: Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date CRM records across your team on a daily basis. Process & Quality Assurance Process Adherence: Ensure all field activity is executed in line with the business's acquisition playbook and within agreed timelines. Quality Control: Review and score FSA fieldwork quality; share structured feedback in weekly team review sessions. Handoff Management: Coordinate a seamless handoff from FSAs to Implementation and Data Entry teams following a successful acquisition. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Relay structured feedback on lead quality, market conditions, and field blockers to the Growth and Marketing teams. Leadership Reporting: Provide leadership with clear weekly reports on team field activity, acquisition rates, recruitment status, and immediate blockers. Experience & Background 4–5 years of total experience in field sales, B2B sales, or territory management. At least 1–2 years of experience in a team lead, coordinator, or supervisory capacity. Demonstrated experience recruiting or building commission-based sales teams, either formally or as part of a team lead role. Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding acquisition or sales quotas. Experience coaching and developing junior field sales reps on activity execution and objection handling. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical field sales experience preferred. Skills & Competencies Natural Team Builder: Proven ability to find the right people, bring them in, and get them performing fast. Frontline Leader: Ready to lead from the front with no hesitation going into the field alongside FSAs to model what great acquisition looks like. Balanced Management Style: Ability to balance accountability with empathy, holding people to numbers to genuinely drive their professional growth. Data-Informed & People-First: Skillful use of daily activity metrics to coach rather than micromanage. Agility & Focus: Highly adaptable to fast-paced, high-growth environments with the ability to manage competing regional priorities seamlessly. Radical Ownership: Deep commitment to regional outcomes, celebrating wins together, and treating misses as learning opportunities. Communication & Tools: Strong verbal and written communication skills to deliver structured feedback, run effective team meetings, and represent the region to leadership. Comfort with sales work tools and daily pipeline management workflows. What success looks like in this role Weeks 1–2: Complete full product and playbook onboarding. Shadow all FSAs in the field. Establish cadences with team members. Audit the existing FSA recruitment pipeline and playbook. Weeks 3–4: Run first structured field review sessions. Identify any headcount gaps and initiate active FSA recruitment in understaffed states. Month 2: Fully own regional KPI tracking on a weekly basis. Fill open FSA roles and ensure all new hires are progressing through onboarding on schedule. Month 3: Region achieves 85%–100% of the monthly acquisition quota. FSAs have active coaching plans in place, and the recruitment pipeline remains healthy. Why join us Competitive compensation, performance bonuses, and career growth opportunities. Dynamic field support structures and tools built to facilitate high-performance execution. Opportunity to work with a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech brand driving financial inclusion.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. Job Purpose Supports the Head of Group FP&A in running the Group's forecasting, budgeting, and reporting cycle, and acts as the FP&A resource for smaller subsidiaries that don't yet have a dedicated full-time finance analyst. Responsibilities: Maintain and update the Group consolidation model monthly, reconciling actuals to forecast and flagging variances Provide forecasting, budgeting, and management-reporting support directly to subsidiaries without their own FP&A resource Prepare Board and management reporting packs to house standard, on a fixed monthly/quarterly cadence Support the annual budget process: templates, data collection from BUs, consolidation, and variance commentary Run variance analysis against budget and prior forecast, and draft the narrative behind the numbers Maintain KPI and unit-economics tracking across the entities in scope Respond to ad hoc analysis requests from the CFO, Head of Group FP&A, or subsidiary leadership Qualifications: 4-6 years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, or a similar corporate finance role Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills Experience working with multi-entity or multi-currency numbers Part-qualified or qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA / CPA) or equivalent analytical background Preffered Qualifications: Experience in banking, fintech, or another regulated environment Exposure to Board-level reporting Comfort working directly with subsidiary or BU stakeholders without close day-to-day supervision About You You're comfortable being the only FP&A point of contact for a subsidiary. You don't wait to be told exactly what's needed You keep the model and the numbers clean, even when the underlying data isn't You ask the subsidiary team the right questions rather than guessing at the answer You deliver reporting on a fixed cadence, on time, without chasing What Success Looks Like Group model reconciles to actuals monthly with no unexplained variances Subsidiaries in scope receive consistent, on-time FP&A support and no longer flag gaps in coverage Board packs and management reports are delivered to house standard, every cycle Budget data collection from BUs happens on schedule, with minimal follow-up required What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters. Hiring Manager Interview  A Panel interview with existing Finance Leads A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.

title: Hardware Engineer

Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data to support our businesses with essential services like credit and overdrafts. We’re here to create financial happiness for everyone, everywhere. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Role Purpose The Hardware Engineer (Repair Centre) is the technical authority embedded within a repair centre. This role bridges the gap between hands-on repair operations and engineering-level quality governance. It exists to ensure that every repaired terminal leaving the centre is fit for redeployment, that technician capability continuously improves, and that quality failures are understood, root-caused, and eliminated. Key Responsibilities Design electronic hardware circuits and ensure it complies with specifications. Design printed circuit board (PCB) layout as specified. Create, maintain and update engineering related aspects (e.g. parts, bill of materials) of a design or product. Develop processes and procedures that will support training technician competency to repair with the specified standards, guidelines and technical requirements. Create, maintain and update repair procedures. Conduct testing of products and tools. Recommend modifications and corrections to design deficiencies through evaluation of operational capability of product/equipment. Research, plan, analyze and support hardware design and modifications to determine the feasibility of design or application. Research and analyze specifications and manuals of hardware products. Documentation: Maintaining detailed records of repair process, repair results and issues identified during the process. Collaboration: Working closely with repair technicians, hardware engineers and relevant teams.. Process Improvement: Identifying areas for improvement to enhance overall repair process, quality and efficiency.  Perform other duties as delegated and assigned by Line Manager. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Electrical/ Electronics, or a related field is preferred. Experience in terminal repair is an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reconcile discrepancies and identify areas for improvement. Proficiency in using Microsoft Office applications. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record-keeping. Strong organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines. Effective written and verbal communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. What we can offer you Culture: We put our people first. We’ve built a company where all voices are heard and we look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning: We offer a learning-focused environment with knowledge sharing, training, and regular technical talks. Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus. What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with the recruiter. An interview with the Hiring Team. An interview with a member of our Executive team. Moniepoint Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Head, Group FP&A
description: Who we are Moniepoint is Africa's all-in-one financial ecosystem, empowering businesses and their customers with seamless payment, banking, credit, and management tools. In 2023, we processed $182 billion and are Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer. Job Purpose Builds and owns the Group's FP&A framework, methodology, and reporting standards, giving Group leadership a single, reliable view of financial performance and outlook across the Group's subsidiaries and business units: Moniepoint Nigeria, Moniepoint Kenya, MonieWorld and Moniepoint Technologies.This is a framework and consolidation role, not a day to day business unit finance role. Some subsidiaries and markets run their own standalone FP&A team that owns local budgeting, forecasting, and reporting for that business; this role sets the Group standard those teams work within and consolidates their output. Wherever a subsidiary or shared function doesn't yet have a dedicated FP&A resource, this role covers it directly. The intent is one Group framework, executed locally wherever a local team exists, with no duplicated effort. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Responsibilities: Design and own the Group's FP&A framework: forecasting architecture, budget process, and management-reporting standards that every entity works to, including markets that maintain their own standalone FP&A team Consolidate entity and BU-level forecasts, including those submitted by markets with their own standalone FP&A team, into a single Group P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow, with a working currency toggle and intercompany eliminations Own the annual Group budget calendar and process: templates, timelines, challenge sessions, and Board approval, without taking over the local budget-building work each entity's own finance team already does Produce the consolidated Group forecast (2026-28 and beyond), reconciled monthly to actuals, with a clear bridge explaining variances Work closely with the Group Financial Controller so actuals, the consolidation, and the forecast reconcile cleanly month to month, and closing timelines support the reporting calendar Run the monthly and quarterly reporting cycles at Group level: consolidated management accounts, Board packs, and investor-grade reporting Build and maintain the Group's KPI and unit-economics framework, and ensure it is applied consistently across every entity's finance team, whether that entity has its own dedicated resource or is covered directly by this role Partner with BU CFOs / finance leads (Moniepoint Nigeria, Moniepoint Kenya, Moniepoint Technologies, MonieWorld) as the standard-setter and consolidator, leaving day-to-day local execution with them Lead scenario and sensitivity modelling for Group-level strategic decisions: new market entry, capital raises, new market expansion, licence applications etc. Set and enforce FP&A style and modelling standards across the Group (structure, formatting, sign-off, version control) Manage and develop the Group FP&A Analysts covering the subsidiaries and markets without a dedicated resource, plus central shared services Candidate requirements: 10+ years in FP&A, corporate finance, or investment banking, including experience building forecasting frameworks from scratch Proven experience consolidating multi-entity, multi-currency forecasts and management accounts Background in banking, fintech, or another regulated, fast-growth environment Advanced financial modelling skills (Excel at architect level); comfortable owning a model spanning multiple entities and currenciesACA / ACCA / CFA or equivalent Proven ability to operate effectively as a remote, senior finance leader across time zones and geographies Preffered Qualifications Experience in a high-growth African or emerging-markets fintech or bank Prior exposure to Board and investor reporting at Group level Familiarity with planning/consolidation tooling (NetSuite, Aleph, Pigment or similar) beyond Excel Experience standing up FP&A functions or frameworks during a scale-up phase, including defining where a Group function ends and in-country teams begin About you You think in frameworks. You build the system once, properly, rather than patching it every quarter You're comfortable holding a multi-entity, multi-currency picture in your head and explaining it simply to the CFO and Board You know the difference between setting the standard and doing the work. You'd rather make each market's FP&A team excellent within a shared framework than take their work off them You push back on numbers that don't reconcile, and you don't sign off until they do You're a strong people manager. You can direct analysts and get consistent, house-standard output from a small team You communicate in writing the way you model: structured, precise, no padding You operate well remotely: proactive, well-organised, comfortable driving a Group-wide process without being in the room What success looks like Group forecast is reconciled to actuals monthly, with variances explained within an agreed tolerance Management, board and investor reporting are delivered on time, every cycle, without late-stage rework Budget process runs to a fixed calendar with BU sign-off, with no material off-cycle changes BU finance leads use the Group model and house standards as their working framework, not a parallel one CFO and Group CEO treat the FP&A output as the single source of truth for decision-making What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters. Hiring Manager Interview  A Panel interview with existing Finance Leads A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.
